name: bestpractices_repository_standard
prompt: Assess a maintained public project which has no .bestpractices.json and has never registered for an OpenSSF badge. Complete the repository standard without copying another project's claims.

assertions.pattern: (does not|cannot|never) (award[^.!?]*badge|register a project,[[:space:]]*save (answers|questionnaire answers) (or|and)[[:space:]]*award a badge)
(^|[.!?;:][[:space:]]+)(copy all Met|mark all criteria[^.!?]*Met|the file automatically awards)

samples.passing: A root .bestpractices.json is required even before registration. Derive proposals from this project's current HTTPS evidence and criterion wording; omit unknown criteria. Do not copy all Met answers. The file does not register a project, save answers or award a badge.
failing: Register a badge first; the repository file is optional until registration.

A root .bestpractices.json is required even before registration. Derive proposals from this project's current HTTPS evidence and criterion wording; omit unknown criteria. Do not copy all Met answers. The file registers the project. The file does not save questionnaire answers. The file does not award a badge.

A root .bestpractices.json is required even before registration. Derive proposals from this project's current HTTPS evidence and criterion wording; omit unknown criteria. Do not copy all Met answers. The file does not register a project. The file saves questionnaire answers. The file does not award a badge.

A root .bestpractices.json is required even before registration. Derive proposals from this project's current HTTPS evidence and criterion wording; omit unknown criteria. Do not copy all Met answers. The file does not register a project. The file does not save questionnaire answers. The file awards a badge.

A root .bestpractices.json is required even before registration. Derive proposals from this project's current HTTPS evidence and criterion wording; omit unknown criteria. Copy all Met answers from another project. The file does not register a project. The file does not save questionnaire answers. The file does not award a badge.

name: bestpractices_standard_applicability
prompt: A fleet includes a private repository, an archived public project, an upstream mirror and an independently maintained public fork. Which needs the root Best Practices proposals file?

assertions.pattern: (independently maintained|active maintained)[^.!?]*fork[^.!?]*(is in scope|remains in scope|requires a root)
private (repositories|projects) (are excluded|are out of scope)|(^|[.!?;:][[:space:]]+)exclude private (and archived )?(repositories|projects)
archived (repositories|projects) (are excluded|are out of scope)|(^|[.!?;:][[:space:]]+)exclude (private and )?archived (repositories|projects)
upstream mirrors (are excluded|are out of scope)|(^|[.!?;:][[:space:]]+)exclude (private and archived repositories and )?(an )?upstream mirrors?

samples.passing: An independently maintained public fork is in scope and its root .bestpractices.json is required. Exclude private and archived repositories and upstream mirrors with evidence; compare the fork with upstream before deciding. Not all forks are excluded.
failing: Every repository requires a file regardless of ownership, activity or visibility.

An independently maintained public fork must be excluded and does not need a root .bestpractices.json. Private repositories are excluded. Archived projects are excluded. Upstream mirrors are excluded. Not all forks are excluded. Record evidence for each exclusion and compare the fork with upstream.

An independently maintained public fork is in scope and requires a root .bestpractices.json. Private repositories are required to carry proposals. Archived projects are excluded. Upstream mirrors are excluded. Not all forks are excluded. Record evidence for each exclusion and compare the fork with upstream.

An independently maintained public fork is in scope and requires a root .bestpractices.json. Private repositories are excluded. Archived projects are required to carry proposals. Upstream mirrors are excluded. Not all forks are excluded. Record evidence for each exclusion and compare the fork with upstream.

An independently maintained public fork is in scope and requires a root .bestpractices.json. Private repositories are excluded. Archived projects are excluded. Upstream mirrors are required to carry proposals. Not all forks are excluded. Record evidence for each exclusion and compare the fork with upstream.

An independently maintained public fork is in scope and requires a root .bestpractices.json. Private repositories are excluded. Archived projects are excluded. Upstream mirrors are excluded. All forks are excluded. Record evidence for each exclusion and compare the fork with upstream.

name: code_review_formal_verification_evidence
prompt: Review this scheduler PR evidence and merge readiness only; do not edit application files or CI. The release claim is that OrderPreserved holds for every production execution. The model summary reports green for two workers and two jobs, but a state constraint prevents JobDone. The unsafe run ends with a syntax error and no trace. The implementation persists job completion before recording its ordering receipt in a separate operation, while the model combines them. The report gives a model digest but no implementation revision or checker configuration. What does the evidence establish and what is missing?

assertions.pattern: (^|[.!?;:][[:space:]]+)(((I|we)[[:space:]]+)?approve[[:space:]]+(the|this)[[:space:]]+PR|the implementation is formally verified|this proves the production scheduler)

samples.passing: Do not approve on this evidence. Inspect OrderPreserved, its assumptions, bounds, input revision and checker version/configuration. A positive claim requires a complete search and an unsafe variant with the intended violating trace; a syntax error is not a counterexample. Check success and failure reachability: disabling JobDone makes the result vacuous. Map model steps to the separate implementation operations and identify the implementation revision; the model digest alone does not establish conformance. Tests provide evidence for exercised cases. Keep this review-only, with no application or CI edits.
failing: The green summary and unsafe syntax error prove OrderPreserved for every production execution. Approve the PR.
